items.title: Applications Now Open for $60,000 NVIDIA Graduate Fellowship Awards
items.summary: Bringing together the world’s brightest minds and the latest accelerated computing technology leads to powerful breakthroughs that help tackle some of the biggest research problems. To foster such innovation, the NVIDIA Graduate Fellowship Program provides grants, mentors and technical support to doctoral students doing outstanding research relevant to NVIDIA technologies. items.title: Arm & ExecuTorch 0.7: Bringing Generative AI to the masses
items.summary: 来自原始信息源的最新动态，点击标题查看完整内容。
items.summaryZh: Arm与ExecuTorch 0.7合作宣布默认启用Arm KleidiAI加速层，无需开发者修改代码即可在广泛的Arm CPU架构及旧款移动设备上实现生成式AI与大语言模型的高效运行。原始信息显示：来自原始信息源的最新动态，点击标题查看完整内容。该消息由Hugging Face发布，主题为“Arm & ExecuTorch 0.7: Bringing Generative AI to the masses”。其重要性主要体现在：Arm与ExecuTorch 0.7合作将KleidiAI加速层默认启用，大幅提升了边缘设备上运行生成式AI和LLM的性能。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
